learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire knowledge and skills in the composition, design and calculations of characteristic units and parts of machine tools.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to design of machine tools
High-speed displacement drives and precise displacement drives
Workpiece and tools handling automatic manipulators
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment is based on written tests. Depending on their results, the student may be exempt from solving problems at the written exam. The problems and questions given in the exam are marked by points. The final grade depends on the exam score and the continuous assessment grade.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
